senses.gloss: m. (קְטַף) [the movement of the grape-cutter,] cut.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:2:1">Koh. R. to X, 2</cite> <he>מחמי ליה ק׳ מן הדין גיסא</he> showed him (with his hand) a cut from that (left)side (threatening punishment; Var. in Matt. K. <he>מחי וכ׳</he> he struck him a cutting blow with his hand).—[<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9:1">Koh. R. to XI, 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00811"><he>קְטַף</he> I</cite>.]
